title: Kernel Echo Tuner: seq-len-aware annealing for multi-arch attention scheduling
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Implement a lightweight, sequence-length-aware kernel selection heuristic ("echo" score + annealing) that harmonizes prefill and decode scheduling across heterogeneous GPU types. The intent is to reduce 95th-percentile latency regressions for mixed-length workloads while preserving throughput and minimizing per-token cost.
updates: 2025-01-18: RFC drafted describing the Echo score (combination of kernel microbenchmark latency, occupancy penalty, and seq-len mismatch factor). Added initial design for an annealing schedule that biases toward lower-latency kernels for short seqs and gradually expands probe space for long seqs.

2025-01-20: Spike completed — microprobe harness added to runtime testbench. Measured per-kernel latency across A100, H100, and RTX-6000 at seq-len buckets [8, 64, 256, 1024]. Results saved to benchmark dashboard (link below).

2025-01-21: Decided to separate prefill and decode decisions: prefill uses conservative Echo-Score with higher occupancy penalty; decode uses fast warmstart with microshard probing limited to first token and periodic re-eval every N tokens. Rationale: prefill burst latency matters for tail; decode benefits from warm KV cache and must prioritize throughput.
2025-01-22: Prototype implemented: echo_tuner module in runtime with pluggable annealing schedules. Integration tests passing on CPU build; GPU CI queued. Created PR #6142 for runtime changes.

2025-01-24: Benchmarks indicate ~12% reduction in p95 latency for mixed 8/256 workload on H100 when using Echo annealer vs baseline static kernel table. CPU overhead of tuner <0.4% of request path. Need more safety nets for noisy microbenchmarks.

2025-01-25: Added safety fallback: if microprobe variance > 8% across last 30 samples, freeze to last known-good kernel for 30s. Planning canary rollout on staging cluster for dedicated instances next week.
acceptance_criteria: Echo tuner implemented as pluggable runtime component with config toggles for prefill and decode policies
p95 latency improvement of >=10% on at least two representative mixed-length benchmarks without >3% throughput regression
Unit and integration tests cover annealing schedules, variance gating, and warmstart behavior
Canary rollout plan documented and automated via console rollout policy (A/B with automatic rollback on latency regression)
Design doc and runbook published with actionable debug telemetry (echo_score breakdown, microprobe histograms, variance metric)
comments: Liam Porter (2025-01-19): Recommend starting with a conservative annealing half-life to avoid oscillation across noisy workload patterns.
Marta Chen (Design) (2025-01-21): UX note — expose tunable safety window in Console and surface recommended presets for Dedicated vs Hosted tiers.
Diego Alvarez (SRE) (2025-01-23): Add circuit-breaker if selection causes >5% observed OOM or kernel launch failures in 1m window.
Aisha Kapoor (2025-01-24): We'll include a telemetry tag to link each decision to a microprobe sample id for postmortem debugging.
